GRADE 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Friendship and Keeping Promises at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a good friendship for a healthy social relationship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

2. About Friendship and Keeping Promises at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish t between good and bad friendship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

3. About Friendship and Keeping Promises when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a good friendship for a healthy social relationship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

5. About Physical Aspect of Yoga at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.

6. About Physical Aspect of Yoga at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.

7. About Physical Aspect of Yoga when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline benefits of environmental protection for communal wellness,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.

9. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers
